summary: Coordinated the 2026-08-21 consolidation: merged the remote console work, pooled and analysed the overnight cohorts, and integrated three concurrent contributors' in-flight work into one record. Analysis contribution: completed and interpreted the depth-by-chance-resolution factorial from already-collected artifacts, establishing that chance resolution changes the SIGN of the depth gradient (fourth ply +86,172 with a 95% lower bound of +26,605 at seven strata, versus -7,723 at five strata) and that the fifth ply is flat at both resolutions; and identified the equal-work equivalence between depth 3 with six-fold reveal sampling and depth 4 with single-sample reveals. Caught and corrected a confounded reading of my own, in which the raw d5s5-versus-d4s7 gap of 109,795 points would have been attributed to depth when it is a chance-resolution effect. Specified and reviewed, but did not implement, the daily research-log feature in web/ (implemented by a delegated agent with its own record); authored the 2026-08-20 and 2026-08-21 log entries and the plain-English overlays for the two afterstate experiments. Coordinator edits to docs/research/status.md and roadmap.md recording the closed directions, and to AGENTS.md and the web-console skill establishing the research-log contract. Did not author the afterstate-learning line, the leaf-reweight experiment, the fast engine, or the playable console; each has its own record.
validationPerformed: make test-typescript: 134 tests, 0 failures, after fast-forwarding to origin/main
cd web && npm run build: passes; /log/2026-08-20 and /log/2026-08-21 prerendered
Re-derived every factorial figure from the cohort artifacts rather than from prior task summaries
Verified each number quoted in the log entries against its source finding document or run artifact
limitations: The depth-5 cells of the factorial are partial: 32 games at five strata and 16 at seven, against 64 for depths 2-4. The depth-5 conclusion is a wash on a small paired sample, not a tight bound.
All factorial evidence is development tier on a single exploratory seed lease and does not upgrade the ledger.
The research-log entries are narrative summaries; they carry no evidence of their own and every number in them is sourced from a record or artifact elsewhere in the repository.
One concurrent contributor's GPU run was still in progress when this record was written, so its outcome is described as running, not as a result.
